name: MMS Ventures Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有发布涉及业务扩张、新业务、缩减、出售或合约的公告，公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及公司秘书变更等事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比大幅下降，净利润转为亏损。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract. Announcements were mainly quarterly results, general meetings, and change of company secretary. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue declined significantly year-on-year and net profit turned into a loss.
